messages:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT: streaming-inference /v1/stream p99 spike in eu-west1 detected. p95=120ms p99=2.8s. error_budget: low. paging oncall. :rotating_light:

Sam (oncall): ACK. looking into it now. grabbing dashboards and tailing streaming logs.

Sam (oncall): infra-bot, fetch GPU telemetry for pool-redwood-eu-west1-3 from 10:00Z to now please. include fan RPM, ECC correctable/counts, and temp.

Infra Bot: pulled metrics: gpu-23 shows rising correctable ECCs (count +48 in last 5m), fan RPM oscillating 1400<->2800, junction temp spikes to 85C, NVLink retries present. logs: /var/log/gpu-monitor/gpu-23.log attached.

Yvette (eng-sre): seeing correlated KV cache miss rate increase and stream stalls pinned to worker on node gpu-23. p99 tails have 200-400ms queuing on that worker.

Kai (runtime): could be thermal dither causing clocks to oscillate -> kernel throttles -> scheduler backs off NVML calls -> streaming stalls. If gpu clocks drop intermittently, KV cache hits timeout and we see tail latency.

Sam (oncall): Matt, can you confirm kernel messages on host? I see a few "THERMAL_THROTTLE" lines in syslog.

Matt - infra: attaching syslog snippet:

```
Mar 10 10:12:34 gpu-node-23 kernel: [  523.123456] GPU 0000:3b:00.0: Thermal event: THERMAL_THROTTLE
Mar 10 10:12:36 gpu-node-23 kernel: [  525.654321] nvidia: GPU 3b:00.0 - ECC correctable error, syndrome 0x1a
Mar 10 10:12:41 gpu-node-23 kernel: [  530.987654] nvlink: retry count exceeded on link 2
```

Matt - infra: I'm recommending we cordon and evacuate node gpu-node-23 to avoid cascading stalls. starting drain now.

Sam (oncall): Agreed. Live mitigation plan:
- set routing policy to avoid pool-redwood-eu-west1-3 (immediate)
- scale up dedicated hot-spare pool by +2 GPUs in eu-west1 (temp)
- enable quantized fallback model v2-q8 on streaming route for 5m to reduce per-request GPU utilization
- cordon gpu-node-23 and start draining sessions

Kai (runtime): Guiding commands:

```
# avoid pool
redwoodctl routing update --route streaming --avoid-pool pool-redwood-eu-west1-3
# fallback model
redwoodctl models rollout --route streaming --fallback model:v2-q8 --ttl 5m
# scale pool
redwoodctl capacity increase --pool pool-hotspare-eu-west1 --gpus 2
```

Sam (oncall): executing now.

Infra Bot: routing updated, pool shrink avoided, hot-spare scale requested (2 GPUs).

Kai (runtime): fallback rollout in progress, traffic shifting to quantized variant for streaming. expect transient quality variance, but much lower GPU clocks.

Priya - CS: FYI one enterprise customer (acct acme-inc) reported delayed responses ~10:12Z; CS is on it and will message customers that we're mitigating.

Yvette (eng-sre): drain started on gpu-node-23. current active sessions 12 -> migrating. I see backlog drain events and worker rebinds.

Matt - infra: cordoned node. starting controlled restart of GPU driver after sessions finish.

Sam (oncall): monitoring SLOs. current p95=130ms p99=420ms (after mitigation). p99 dropped from 2.8s to 420ms within ~90s of routing change and fallback.

Kai (runtime): good improvement. will keep fallback for 5m and then evaluate if we can reintroduce full model to subset of traffic. we should also mark node for hardware follow-up (possible fan controller/heat sink issue).

Priya - CS: I'll keep customers updated. tagging legal for any SLA notifications if needed.

Yvette (eng-sre): creating incident record for postmortem: tagging node gpu-node-23, ECC correctables, fan oscillation, NVLink retries.

Sam (oncall): action items:
- Matt: hardware diagnostics + replacement ticket for gpu-23 (ETA: 24h)
- Kai: follow-up on scheduling/clocks behavior and tuning for thermal hysteresis
- Yvette: postmortem with timeline and mitigation steps
- Priya: customer impact note + support thread

Sam (oncall): closing the live mitigation window. Observability live: p99 stable ~380-450ms. leaving monitoring handover with eng-sre for 2h.

Oncall Bot: EVENT: mitigation applied. monitoring for 30m.

Matt - infra: opened HW ticket #HW-88934, ordering replacement fan assembly and scheduling on-call swap.

Yvette (eng-sre): will run repro load tomorrow to validate thermal dither under sustained 90% utilization.

Sam (oncall): Thanks team. will post full incident write-up once we have driver logs and HW verification. :white_check_mark:
